appraisal_events.evidence: les traits de son visage concentrés, accouplés dans le réseau de son animation, les yeux étincelants, enflammés d'un ensoleillement radieux de gaîté que seuls avaient le pouvoir de faire rayonner ainsi les propos, fussent-ils tenus par la princesse elle-même, qui étaient une louange de son esprit ou de sa beauté
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's elaborate account of the princess's radiant delight at being told she embodies 'l'esprit des Guermantes' exposes that only praise of her own wit or beauty, even self-administered, can produce such joy, subtly ironizing her vanity beneath the surface compliment.

appraisal_events.evidence: Mon petit Charles ! Ah ! enfin il vient, je commençais à supposer qu'il ne voulait pas me voir !
appraisal_events.explanation: The princess's eager, affectionate exclamation shows she has been anxiously watching for Swann and warmly values his presence, and the narrator confirms the regard is mutual and that Swann skillfully deploys the manner that pleases her.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's ironizing gloss lowers her locally by revealing that her radiant joy is triggered by any flattery of her own wit or beauty, even from herself.
Swann is warmly and eagerly welcomed by the princess, reflecting genuine mutual affection reinforced by the narrator's note of his own fondness for her.
Swann is shown deploying a practiced, half-artistic, half-gallant manner that he knows will please the princess, giving him local social finesse.
